entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 18th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's fine. I just don't want it.

I understand. I do need to let you know, Sarah, that since the VeloBand Pulse is a health device that syncs personal data, it has a strict 10-day return policy. Looking at the delivery date, we are on day 15, which is just outside that window.
Of course it is. Just my luck. It's not like I had time to worry about a return policy while my husband was in the hospital.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay. Was there a medical emergency that prevented you from contacting us sooner?
He needed an unexpected surgery. And right after that, his unit got an early deployment notice. So, no, returning this band wasn't exactly my top priority.

Thank you for sharing that with me, Sarah. I completely understand. Given the circumstances with the emergency surgery and the upcoming deployment, we can absolutely make a one-time exception. I will process a full refund for you immediately.

Alright, I've just processed that for you. You'll see the full amount refunded to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. You'll also receive a pre-paid return label in your email to send the device back to us. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Okay. Well, I wish your husband a safe deployment and a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
